title: thymus collinus
intro: Thymus collinus, commonly known as alpine thyme, is a low-growing, woody perennial plant belonging to the mint family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Thymus collinus include acting as an anti-anxiety agent, a circulatory stimulant, and a expectorant, making it useful for respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Thymus collinus include thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
